body:
[A10] Recorded from the #401 lane (PR #460): `python3 avdecc/gen_aem_store.py --self-test` exits 1 at dev 36ee8a37, identically before and after that lane's change, and no workflow step runs it, so the failure is invisible.

## Objective

The self-test passes or is deleted, and whichever survives is wired into the docs-check carrier's step list so it cannot rot again.

## Acceptance

1. The failing assertion is named here with its cause (a stale expectation or a real defect in the store generator).
2. `python3 avdecc/gen_aem_store.py --self-test` exits 0 on dev, or the self-test is removed with the reason recorded.
3. If kept: a step in the docs-check carrier runs it (the workflow hunk needs a maintainer push: the lane token has no workflow scope) and `scripts/ci_events.py` recognises the step.

Executor and reviewers: assigned when the lane opens.

milestone.title: Software Defined Stack
milestone.description: Every aspect of the milan stack should be at compile time software definable.

title: [Tooling] avdecc/gen_aem_store.py --self-test exits 1 on dev and no workflow runs it
